description: snapchat: User Profile. GET /v1/snapchat/profile. Get a public Snapchat profile (1 credit): name, bio, subscriber count, related accounts and the profile's Spotlight videos with views, shares and comments. Personal accounts return only username, display name and snapcode. Highlights are empty: the public page no longer embeds them. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.
name: snapchat_profile
